_comment: Which laws Ranger can search. Oklahoma titles come from the Legislature's complete-title PDFs; federal parts (none yet) come from the eCFR API. 'include' is a list of regular expressions matched against section ids like 63-683.24E. 'bills' fill in new-law sections a title PDF doesn't have yet (the title's text wins once it does). Edit this file, or the Statute library page in the admin panel, to change what Ranger knows.

oklahoma.name: Public Health and Safety
oklahoma._why: The camp safety law (HB 1675: 63 O.S. 683.24C-683.24K), recreational campground emergency action plans (63 O.S. 681), and the rest of the Oklahoma Emergency Management Act (county and local emergency management)

oklahoma.name: Officers
oklahoma._why: Governmental Tort Claims Act (151-200): municipal liability for parks, camps and campgrounds

oklahoma.name: Waters and Water Rights
oklahoma._why: Oklahoma Floodplain Management Act (1601-1619): floodplain administrators and flood hazard areas, for hazard exposure zones

bills.name: HB 1675 (2026), enrolled
bills._why: Fallback for the camp safety sections until the Legislature's Title 63 PDF includes them

_required: Sections every build must contain. The build fails if one is missing, and Ranger keeps using the last good library. 'mention' warns when a section's text lacks a word (e.g. 63-681 should mention campgrounds once HB 1675's amendment is in the title PDF).
